description: Get historical CHF exchange rates for a currency from the Swiss National Bank (SNB). Returns monthly average rates with optional date filtering. Without date range, returns the most recent 90 months.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. 'EUR', 'USD', 'GBP'). Use list_currencies to see all available codes.

from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM format (e.g. '2020-01'). Optional.

to.description: End date in YYYY-MM format (e.g. '2026-02'). Optional.

name: get_exchange_rate_history
